statement: ∀ {n p : ℕ}, n < p → n.factorization p = 0
∀ {n p : ℕ}, n.factorization p ≠ 0 → p ∣ n
∀ {p r : ℕ} (i : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → r ≠ 0 → (¬p ∣ r ↔ (p * i + r).factorization p = 0)

doc: The only numbers with empty prime factorization are `0` and `1`
statement: ∀ (n : ℕ), n.factorization = 0 ↔ n = 0 ∨ n = 1

doc: Modified version of `factorization_prod` that accounts for inputs.
statement:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {p : ℕ} {S : Finset α} {g : α → ℕ},
  (∀ x ∈ S, g x ≠ 0) → (S.prod g).factorization p = ∑ x ∈ S, (g x).factorization p

doc: A product over `n.factorization` can be written as a product over `n.primeFactors`;
statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} {β : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid β] (f : ℕ → ℕ → β),
  n.factorization.prod f = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, f p (n.factorization p)

doc: A product over `n.primeFactors` can be written as a product over `n.factorization`;
statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} {β : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid β] (f : ℕ → β),
  ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, f p = n.factorization.prod fun p x => f p

doc: The multiplicity of prime `p` in `p` is `1`
statement: ∀ {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p.factorization p = 1
∀ {p n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → (p ^ n).factorization p = n

doc: If the factorization of `n` contains just one number `p` then `n` is a power of `p`
statement: ∀ {n p k : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n.factorization = Finsupp.single p k → n = p ^ k

doc: The only prime factor of prime `p` is `p` itself.
statement: ∀ {p q : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p.factorization q ≠ 0 → p = q
∀ (n p : ℕ), ¬Nat.Prime p → p ^ n.factorization p = 1
∀ (n p : ℕ), ¬Nat.Prime p → n / p ^ n.factorization p = n
∀ (n p : ℕ), n / p ^ n.factorization p ∣ n
∀ (n p : ℕ), 0 < p ^ n.factorization p
∀ {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → p ^ n.factorization p ≤ n
∀ {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → 0 < n / p ^ n.factorization p
∀ (n p : ℕ), n / p ^ n.factorization p ≤ n
∀ (n p : ℕ), p ^ n.factorization p * (n / p ^ n.factorization p) = n
∀ {a b : ℕ} (p : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → p ^ (a * b).factorization p = p ^ a.factorization p * p ^ b.factorization p
∀ (a b p : ℕ), a * b / p ^ (a * b).factorization p = a / p ^ a.factorization p * (b / p ^ b.factorization p)

doc: A crude upper bound on `n.factorization p`
statement: ∀ {n : ℕ} (p : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → n.factorization p < n

doc: A weak upper bound on `n.factorization p`
statement: ∀ {n p : ℕ}, p * n.factorization p ≤ n

doc: An upper bound on `n.factorization p`
statement: ∀ {n p b : ℕ}, n ≤ p ^ b → n.factorization p ≤ b
∀ {d n : ℕ}, d ≠ 0 → n ≠ 0 → ((∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → d.factorization p ≤ n.factorization p) ↔ d ∣ n)
∀ {a b : ℕ}, b ≠ 0 → a.factorization ≤ (a * b).factorization
∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ≠ 0 → b.factorization ≤ (a * b).factorization
∀ {p k n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → (p ^ k ∣ n ↔ k ≤ n.factorization p)
∀ {p k n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → (p ^ k ∣ n ↔ p ^ k ∣ p ^ n.factorization p)
∀ {p n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → (p ∣ n ↔ 1 ≤ n.factorization p)
∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ≠ 0 → a < b → ∃ p, a.factorization p < b.factorization p
∀ {d n : ℕ}, d ∣ n → (n / d).factorization = n.factorization - d.factorization
∀ {n p : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → Nat.Prime p → p ∣ n → p ∣ p ^ n.factorization p
∀ {n p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → ¬p ∣ n / p ^ n.factorization p
∀ {n p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → p.Coprime (n / p ^ n.factorization p)
∀ (n p : ℕ), (n / p ^ n.factorization p).factorization = Finsupp.erase p n.factorization
∀ {p k : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ^ (p ^ k).factorization p = p ^ k
∀ {p k : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ^ k / p ^ (p ^ k).factorization p = 1
∀ (n k : ℕ) {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ^ k * n / p ^ (p ^ k * n).factorization p = n / p ^ n.factorization p
∀ (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → (n / p ^ n.factorization p = n ↔ n = 0 ∨ ¬p ∣ n)
∀ {m : ℕ} (k : ℕ) {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → ¬p ∣ m → p ^ k * m / p ^ (p ^ k * m).factorization p = m
∀ (k m : ℕ) {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → (p ^ k * m / p ^ (p ^ k * m).factorization p = m ↔ m = 0 ∨ ¬p ∣ m)
∀ (k : ℕ) {x p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ^ k ∣ x → x / p ^ k / p ^ (x / p ^ k).factorization p = x / p ^ x.factorization p
∀ {x p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → p ∣ x → x / p / p ^ (x / p).factorization p = x / p ^ x.factorization p
∀ {p d n : ℕ}, d ∣ n → ¬p ∣ d → d ∣ n / p ^ n.factorization p

doc:
If `n` is a nonzero natural number and `p ≠ 1`, then there are natural numbers `e`
and `n'` such that `n'` is not divisible by `p` and `n = p^e * n'`.

Any nonzero natural number is the product of an odd part `m` and a power of
two `2 ^ k`.
statement: ∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → ∃ k m, Odd m ∧ n = 2 ^ k * m
∀ {d n : ℕ}, d ≠ 0 → d ≤ n → (d ∣ n ↔ (n / d).factorization = n.factorization - d.factorization)
∀ {a b : ℕ}, b ≠ 0 → a ∣ b → ∀ (p : ℕ), p ^ a.factorization p ∣ p ^ b.factorization p
∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ∣ b → ∀ (p : ℕ), a / p ^ a.factorization p ∣ b / p ^ b.factorization p
∀ (a b : ℕ), (∀ (p : ℕ), a / p ^ a.factorization p ∣ b / p ^ b.factorization p) ↔ a ∣ b
∀ (n d : ℕ), d ∣ n ↔ ∀ (p k : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → p ^ k ∣ d → p ^ k ∣ n
∀ (n : ℕ), ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ∣ n
∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a.gcd b).factorization = a.factorization ⊓ b.factorization
∀ {a b : ℕ}, a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a.lcm b).factorization = a.factorization ⊔ b.factorization

∀ {β : Type u_1} [inst : AddCommMonoid β] (m n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → β),
  (m.gcd n).primeFactors.sum f + (m * n).primeFactors.sum f = m.primeFactors.sum f + n.primeFactors.sum f

∀ {β : Type u_1} [inst : CommMonoid β] (m n : ℕ) (f : ℕ → β),
  (m.gcd n).primeFactors.prod f * (m * n).primeFactors.prod f = m.primeFactors.prod f * n.primeFactors.prod f
∀ {n p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → {i | i ≠ 0 ∧ p ^ i ∣ n} = Set.Icc 1 (n.factorization p)

doc:
The set of positive powers of prime `p` that divide `n` is exactly the set of
positive natural numbers up to `n.factorization p`.
statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → Finset.Icc 1 (n.factorization p) = {i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n}
∀ (n : ℕ) {p : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n.factorization p = {i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n}.card
∀ {n p b : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → n ≤ p ^ b → {i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n} = {i ∈ Finset.Icc 1 b | p ^ i ∣ n}
∀ {n p b : ℕ}, Nat.Prime p → n ≠ 0 → n < p ^ b → {i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 n | p ^ i ∣ n} = {i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b | p ^ i ∣ n}

doc:
The factorization of `m` in `n` is the number of positive natural numbers `i` such that `m ^ i`
divides `n`. Note `m` is prime. This set is expressed by filtering `Ico 1 b` where `b` is any bound
greater than `log m n`.
statement: ∀ {b m n : ℕ}, Nat.Prime m → 0 < n → n < m ^ b → n.factorization m = {i ∈ Finset.Ico 1 b | m ^ i ∣ n}.card

doc:
If `p` is a prime factor of `a` then the power of `p` in `a` is the same that in `a * b`,
for any `b` coprime to `a`.
statement: ∀ {p a b : ℕ}, a.Coprime b → p ∈ a.primeFactorsList → (a * b).factorization p = a.factorization p

doc:
If `p` is a prime factor of `b` then the power of `p` in `b` is the same that in `a * b`,
for any `a` coprime to `b`.
statement: ∀ {p a b : ℕ}, a.Coprime b → p ∈ b.primeFactorsList → (a * b).factorization p = b.factorization p

doc: Two positive naturals are equal if their prime padic valuations are equal
statement: ∀ (a b : ℕ), a ≠ 0 → b ≠ 0 → (a = b ↔ ∀ (p : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → padicValNat p a = padicValNat p b)
∀ (n : ℕ), n ≠ 0 → ∀ (m : ℕ), n < m → ∏ p ∈ Finset.range m with Nat.Prime p, p ^ padicValNat p n = n
∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n = ∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p ^ n.factorization p
∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n = ∏ p, ↑p ^ n.factorization ↑p
∀ {n : ℕ}, Pairwise (Function.onFun Nat.Coprime fun p => ↑p ^ n.factorization ↑p)
∀ {n : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → n ∣ (∏ p ∈ n.primeFactors, p) ^ n
∀ {n k : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 → (n ∣ k ^ n ↔ n.primeFactors ⊆ k.primeFactors)
∀ {n k : ℕ}, n ≠ 0 → k ≠ 0 → ((∃ m, n ∣ k ^ m) ↔ n.primeFactors ⊆ k.primeFactors)

doc:
Exactly `n / p` naturals in `[1, n]` are multiples of `p`.
See `Nat.card_multiples'` for an alternative spelling of the statement.
statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ), {e ∈ Finset.range n | p ∣ e + 1}.card = n / p

doc: Exactly `n / p` naturals in `(0, n]` are multiples of `p`.
statement: ∀ (n p : ℕ), {x ∈ Finset.Ioc 0 n | p ∣ x}.card = n / p

doc:
There are exactly `⌊N/n⌋` positive multiples of `n` that are `≤ N`.
See `Nat.card_multiples` for a "shifted-by-one" version.
statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ), {k ∈ Finset.range N.succ | k ≠ 0 ∧ n ∣ k}.card = N / n
∀ {a b m n : ℕ}, m.Coprime n → a ^ m = b ^ n → ∃ c, a = c ^ n ∧ b = c ^ m
∀ {a b m n : ℕ}, m ≠ 0 ∨ n ≠ 0 → a ^ m = b ^ n → ∃ c, a = c ^ (n / m.gcd n) ∧ b = c ^ (m / m.gcd n)
